summary: Re-review of powdr-labs__apc-optimizer unit RRU-5769f3ada611 (67 changed/added files, scope `.`, whole repository). Prior review RRV-5769f3ada611-r1 retained the repository as a verified constraint-system optimizer with explicit circuit semantics and correctness theorems. Independently re-inspected all 67 currently-listed files: 64 hold genuine formal content (circuit/VM specification, audit/legality proofs against real benchmark circuit dumps, and implementation/correctness theorems, plus three pure import aggregators protected by FILTER-007). Three files are excluded: `docs/Docs.lean`, a Verso-generated narrative manual whose code blocks are verbatim ANCHOR-extracted duplicates of declarations already indexed in `ApcOptimizer/Spec.lean`, and `Scripts/CheckAxioms.lean`/`Scripts/UnusedTheorems.lean`, CI tooling that inspects the Lean elaboration environment (axiom-dependency printing, dead-theorem detection) and declares no domain-mathematical content of its own.
